## Requirements (contract)

1. **Typed assertion envelope + adapter** — own `sig.assertion/1` and the named, versioned
   `sig.assertion.map.v1` connector→sink mapping; preserve every qualifier/epistemic/time/privacy
   field; explicit basis strings for every default — missing information never silently strengthens.
2. **Actual capture persistence** — additive sqitch `claim_assertion_bindings`; LinkML/ontology
   slots, classes and enums for capture/extraction/claim/qualifier/evidence; `evidence_capture`
   occurrences keyed `(artifact, digest, retrieved_at)` — identical bytes → one deduplicated blob +
   immutable per-acquisition occurrences.
3. **Live occurrences + no-network replay bound to real bytes** — `CaptureRef` carries
   `ocfl_object_id`/`ocfl_version`/`original_run_id`; `OcflCaptureStore` resolves version-pinned
   reads (never a mutable head sidecar); replay binds the ORIGINAL occurrence and keeps its
   observation time while the replay's own assertion time lands on `sys_period`/`bound_at`.
4. **Honest evidence kinds** — `binding_status` (`actual_capture`/`replayed`/`document_only`/
   `legacy_synthetic`) × `capture_classification` (`actual`/`synthetic`/`legacy`); the no-binding
   legacy path is never presented as byte-anchored provenance.
5. **Fail-closed unknowns** — `assertion_quarantine` (append-only; bad digest / missing binding /
   unknown object·value kind / unsupported locator / missing required field / unknown qualifier /
   unknown predicate / version mismatch / extractor failure), deterministic `payload_digest`
   (+0 re-runs), restricted+sealed read roles only.
6. **D-P31.1-3 route half** — an existing entity with unregistered predicates still serves its
   eligible registered facts; unknown predicates are named on `unregistered_predicates`, never a
   whole-entity 404 and never a guessed definition; the direct resolution route keeps its 404;
   restricted claims stay withheld.

## Plan → landed

1. `docs/build/reports/p32.2-assertions/FIELD_MAP.md` — published BEFORE adapters (deliverable 4):
   every six-stream field category mapped to existing LinkML/DB homes; only missing typed fields added.
2. LinkML: `common.yaml` enums (ClaimPolarity/Rank, ReviewStatus, ObservedAtKind, LocatorKind,
   BindingStatus, CaptureClassification, QuarantineReason); `entities.yaml` typed slots on
   Claim/EvidenceCapture/Extraction + ClaimEvidence/ClaimQualifier/AssertionQuarantine classes;
   `make gen` regenerated every artifact deterministically (committed separately — verify-gen clean).
3. Sqitch `claim_assertion_bindings` (deploy/revert/verify): typed claim columns, `claim_evidence`
   locator/binding/extraction columns, `claim_qualifier` typed columns, `evidence_capture`
   occurrence key + classification, `assertion_quarantine`, grants, append-only protections.
4. `db/assertion.py` — `sig.assertion/1` envelope + `sig.assertion.map.v1` adapter + `binding_of`
   + `quarantine_payload`; `db/claim_sink.py` — real-capture binding, typed persistence, qualifiers,
   quarantine, resighting/duplicate links, replay lineage.
5. Connectors — `ClaimSink.assert_claims(claims, *, capture)` pass-through; replay supplies the
   original-occurrence binding; `OcflCaptureStore` version pinning.
6. API — entity route resolves each predicate independently; `unregistered_predicates` on
   `EntityResponse` (D-P31.1-3 route half).
7. ADR-121 + Appendix F + `BUILD.sh`; BL-058 sources += ADR-121 + BACKLOG.md re-rendered;
   DEFERRALS D-P31.1-3 → DONE; closeout docs.
